title: Upper Power: Press
warmup: 2 rounds: 1:00 bike or jog · 10 band pull-aparts · 10 push-ups · 5 light med ball slams
jumps: Bench press 3 → Plyo push-up 5 → Med ball chest pass 5 → Med ball slam 5
Bench @ RPE 8 with a spotter or safeties · Rest 3:00 between rounds · every jump max intent
strength: Drive from the legs, finish tall
note: Throw the med ball like you're trying to break it.
